article_title: New walk-in mental health centres to open in banks and libraries across England

tasks.prompt: What is the main purpose of the new mental health centres?
options: To replace every GP surgery in England
To provide earlier, easier access to mental health support
To offer only long-term hospital treatment
To train bank and library staff as doctors
tasks.correct_answer: To provide earlier, easier access to mental health support
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מטרת המרכזים היא לאפשר לאנשים לקבל תמיכה נפשית מוקדם יותר ובקרבת מקום, לפני שמצבם מחמיר.

tasks.prompt: How many new community mental health centres are planned?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: התכנית כוללת 100 מרכזי בריאות נפש קהילתיים חדשים.

tasks.prompt: Where could some of the community centres be located?
options: Only inside major hospitals
In banks, libraries and other high-street locations
Only at universities
Inside police stations
tasks.correct_answer: In banks, libraries and other high-street locations
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציינת שהמרכזים עשויים לפעול בבנקים, בספריות ובמיקומים נגישים נוספים ברחוב הראשי.

tasks.prompt: What will people need before using the walk-in community centres?
options: A referral from a GP
A private insurance policy
A hospital discharge letter
No referral
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המרכזים מיועדים לקבלת קהל ללא הפניה מרופא משפחה וללא המתנה של חודשים.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “lifeline” suggest about the new centres?
options: They may provide urgently needed help to people in distress
They will teach people how to swim
They will operate only by telephone
They will replace all existing therapists
tasks.correct_answer: They may provide urgently needed help to people in distress
tasks.explanation_hebrew: lifeline משמש כאן בהשאלה לשירות חיוני שעשוי לעזור לאנשים במצוקה בזמן שהם ממתינים לטיפול.

tasks.prompt: What does “dedicated mental health emergency department” mean?
options: A general waiting room used for every illness
A temporary office for financial advice
A service designed specifically for mental health crises
A library section containing medical books
tasks.correct_answer: A service designed specifically for mental health crises
tasks.explanation_hebrew: dedicated פירושו ייעודי; המחלקה מתוכננת במיוחד לטיפול מהיר ורגוע במשבר נפשי.

tasks.prompt: Explain the difference between “immediate”, “specialist” and “community” support in the article. Answer in 2–3 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שמיידי מתייחס למהירות, מומחה לסוג הידע המקצועי, וקהילתי למיקום ושירות קרובים למקום מגורי המטופל.
expected_points: Immediate support is available without a long delay
Specialist support is provided by professionals trained in mental health
Community support is delivered locally rather than only in a hospital

tasks.prompt: Why might a calm specialist department be better than a general A&E for someone in a mental health crisis? Answer in 2–3 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסיק שסביבה רגועה וצוות מומחה עשויים להפחית מצוקה, לאפשר הערכה מהירה ולהימנע מהמתנה ארוכה במחלקה כללית עמוסה.
expected_points: A calm environment may reduce distress
Specialist staff can assess mental health needs quickly
It may avoid long waits in a busy general emergency department

tasks.prompt: Write a 70–100 word summary including the number and type of centres, access arrangements, funding and intended benefit.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול 100 מרכזים קהילתיים, 59 מחלקות חירום ייעודיות, כניסה ללא הפניה, השקעה של 343 מיליון ליש״ט והמטרה לספק עזרה מוקדמת וקרובה לבית.
expected_points: The plan includes 100 community mental health centres
It also includes 59 dedicated mental health emergency departments
Community centres will offer walk-in help without a GP referral
The rollout is backed by £343 million
The aim is earlier local support and better crisis care

tasks.prompt: Using evidence from the article, explain one benefit and one implementation risk of locating mental health support in familiar community buildings. Write 3–4 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין יתרון כגון נגישות והפחתת סטיגמה, לצד סיכון מעשי שהכתבה מעלה כגון מחסור בכוח אדם או צורך להשתלב היטב בשירותים הקיימים.
expected_points: Identify easier local access as a possible benefit
Explain how familiar locations may encourage earlier help-seeking
Identify adequate staffing or integration with existing services as a risk
Use at least one specific detail from the plan
